eps.ov: A princess left to die, a brother out for revenge, and a student in caught in a conspiracy.
eps.oa: أميرة تُركت لتموت، وأخ يسعى إلى الانتقام، وطالب عالق في مؤامرة.

eps.t: He Said She Was Very Beautiful
eps.ov: Mahiro has told Yoshino to leave the city while he can, before he can Evangeline stops him and Yoshino has to make a life or death choice.
eps.oa: طلب «ماهيرو» من «يوشينو» أن يغادر المدينة ما دام قادراً، لكن «إيفانجلين» توقفه قبل أن يفعل، فيُضطر يوشينو إلى اختيار مصيري بين الحياة والموت.

eps.t: There Are Things Even Magic Cannot Do
eps.ov: Against Hakaze's sound advice, Mahiro continues his battle against the mage Natsumura. Hakaze has to help Yoshino save Mahiro’s life.
eps.ta: أشياء لا يقدر عليها حتى السحر
eps.oa: خلافاً لنصيحة «هاكازي» السديدة، يواصل «ماهيرو» قتاله ضد الساحر «ناتسومورا». وعلى هاكازي أن تساعد «يوشينو» على إنقاذ حياة ماهيرو.

eps.ov: Just after arriving at the next town another fruit has appeared. While waiting out the storm, Yoshino and Mahiro take shelter in an abandon house, sharing the tale on how they became friends to Hakaze.
eps.oa: بعد وصولهما إلى البلدة التالية مباشرة تظهر ثمرة أخرى. وبينما ينتظران انقضاء العاصفة يحتمي «يوشينو» و«ماهيرو» في بيت مهجور، ويحكيان لـ«هاكازي» كيف صارا صديقين.

eps.ov: Following the Fruit of Exodus should lead Mahiro and Yoshino to them Samon, but along the way they still must find talisman to obstruct the summing ritual.
eps.oa: يُفترض أن تقود «ثمرة الخروج» «ماهيرو» و«يوشينو» إلى «سامون»، لكن عليهما في الطريق أن يجدا تعويذة تعرقل طقس الاستدعاء.

eps.ov: After discovering that Hakaze might be dead, Mahiro and Yoshino start to question their goal. But before they could ask Hakaze any questions they are attacked, but not by the mages.
eps.oa: بعد أن يكتشف «ماهيرو» و«يوشينو» أن «هاكازي» قد تكون ميتة، يبدآن يشككان في غايتهما. لكن قبل أن يطرحا عليها أي سؤال يتعرضان لهجوم، ولا يأتي من السحرة.

eps.ov: While Hakaze sleeps, Yoshino thinks back to the time he, Mahiro, and Aika spent time at their summer house looking at the stars.
eps.oa: بينما تنام «هاكازي» يستعيد «يوشينو» الوقت الذي قضاه هو و«ماهيرو» و«أيكا» في البيت الصيفي يتأملون النجوم.

eps.t: The Hour to Suppress the Princess
eps.ov: As the joint military strike begins against the barrier protecting the Tree of Exodus, Mahiro and Yoshino heads straight to the tree, but before they make it, Samon is there to greet them.
eps.oa: مع بدء الضربة العسكرية المشتركة على الحاجز الذي يحمي «شجرة الخروج»، يتوجه «ماهيرو» و«يوشينو» مباشرة إلى الشجرة، لكن «سامون» يستقبلهما قبل أن يبلغاها.

eps.ov: With Hakaze dead, her usefulness has ended. Mahiro offers the same deal he made with Hakaze for Aika killer. Seeing that Mahiro is willing to destroy the world, Yoshino finally makes his stand.
eps.oa: بموت «هاكازي» انتهت فائدتها، فيعرض «ماهيرو» الصفقة نفسها التي عقدها مع هاكازي مقابل قاتل «أيكا». وحين يرى «يوشينو» أن ماهيرو مستعد لتدمير العالم، يحسم موقفه أخيراً.

eps.t: How to Make a Time Machine
eps.ov: Convincing Mahiro to give him a chance was the easy part. Yoshino now has to prove the time difference is a myth in hopes of bringing Mahiro back to Hakaze’s side.
eps.oa: كان إقناع «ماهيرو» بمنحه فرصة الجزء السهل. فعلى «يوشينو» الآن أن يثبت أن فارق الزمن وهم، أملاً في أن يعيد ماهيرو إلى صف «هاكازي».

eps.ov: The mystery of the cage is solved, but how can the paradox of time travel confirmed to logic of the Tree of Genesis. Samon has underestimated Hakaze allies and knows it’s just a matter of time before all is revealed.
eps.oa: يُحل لغز القفص، لكن كيف تتوافق مفارقة السفر عبر الزمن مع منطق «شجرة البدء»؟ وقد استهان «سامون» بحلفاء «هاكازي»، ويعلم أن انكشاف كل شيء مسألة وقت.

eps.ov: The Tree of Exodus has revived, but Hakaze is still trapped on the island.
eps.oa: استيقظت «شجرة الخروج»، لكن «هاكازي» ما زالت حبيسة الجزيرة.

eps.ov: Mahiro knows he is dead, but he is at home having a conversation with Aika. He relives the moments of his life leading up to the return of Kusaribe Hakaze and his last moments.
Mahiro has been asked to do the impossible, meanwhile Yoshino and the Princess continue to tour the land and the effects the Tree of Genesis had. Along the way they meet a peculiar young man…

eps.t: You Seem to Be Plotting Something
eps.ov: As Mahiro interrogates the alleged mage of Exodus, Jun meets with the Princess to question her true feelings of Yoshino.

The mage of Exodus has finally made his flashy debut destroying a tree in front of millions. During the performance, Hakaze mind is elsewhere as information of a spy infiltrating the Kusaribe village and reporting of a ghost sends her heading home.
Hakaze tries to learn more about Yoshino's girlfriend to talk herself out of liking him. At the same time Samon and his team are trying to determine who Yoshino’s girlfriend is.
From love come the birth of the Dancing Princess, but what will anger lead Mahiro to do when he finds Yoshino?
As Eva explains to Hakaze what she believes where the Trees come from, Yoshino lays it all out for Mahiro.
Hakaze plans to the impossible twice and if she survives it could change Mahiro and Yoshino lives forever.
Fuwa Aika killer is...
Hakaze has explained everything to Mahiro and Yoshino and as Aika predicted, they have taken it quite well. Hanemura, on the other hand, can’t believe what he is hearing and rages.
The team assembles to take on the world’s governments and the tree. Everything hinges on the performance of the Dancing Princess and mage of Exodus.
Aika lived according to the script of the mage of Exodus; Yoshino refuses to live by such foolishness.
